import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 250010;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] bits = new int[MAXN];
    static long[][] x = new long[26][MAXN];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] invFact = new long[MAXN];
    static long base, result;
    static BufferedReader br;
    static BufferedWriter bw;

    static long qpow(long baseVal, int y) {
        long res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = res * baseVal % p;
            baseVal = baseVal * baseVal % p;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long compute(int depth, int num) {
        if (bits[num] < depth) return 0;
        if (depth == 1) return x[depth][num];
        if (x[depth][num] != 0) return x[depth][num];
        int count = 0;
        int mask = num & (num - 1);
        while (mask != 0) {
            if (bits[mask] >= depth - 1) {
                x[depth][num] += compute(depth - 1, mask) * x[num ^ mask][num];
                if (++count == 18) {
                    count = 0;
                    x[depth][num] %= p;
                }
            }
            mask = (mask - 1) & num;
        }
        x[depth][num] %= p;
        return x[depth][num];
    }

    static long choose(int n, int m) {
        return fact[n] * invFact[m] % p * invFact[n - m] % p;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        bw = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
        }

        base = qpow(k, n);
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            bw.write(Long.toString(base));
            bw.newLine();
            bw.flush();
            return;
        }

        int lim = Math.min(k, bits[n]);
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        }
        invFact[n] = qpow(fact[n], p - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
        }

        result = 0;
        for (int i = lim; i >= 1; i--) {
            result += choose(k, i) * compute(i, n);
        }
        result %= p;
        base = (base - result * fact[n] % p + p) % p;
        bw.write(Long.toString(base));
        bw.newLine();
        bw.flush();
    }
}
